study_class: Retrospective quality control of public archive coordinates. New numeric endpoints can be opened under this engineering protocol. A separate production Lead requires its own grant and prospective decision record.
per_deposit_registration: Record initial hypotheses before first access. Before opening the next deposit, preserve the chosen prediction, scope, metric, intended interpretation and stage event.
atom_matching: Common label position, matched residue identity and atom name in all three chains. Use the pinned geometry method selection, occupancy and alternate location rules. Compare deposits separately.
block_universe: Include all intervals from position 1 through the last declared polymer position or observed selected-chain position, whichever is larger.

delta_angle_deg.definition: absolute difference of unsigned rotation angles from proper fits before and after deletion

delta_rmsd_angstrom.definition: absolute difference of fitted RMSD scalars from proper fits before and after deletion

comparison: Unrounded values; strict greater-than. Flag if validation tolerance overlaps the reporting threshold. Missing, insufficient or nonidentifiable fits are NA.
hidden_exception: For each endpoint and block independently: absolute difference between the three-pair medians before and after deletion within tolerance and at least one individual pair exceeds tolerance.

dispersed_reference.pool: All matched positions outside the tested interval; interval eligibility for block deletion does not limit individual control positions.
dispersed_reference.sort: Lexicographic SHA-256 digest bytes of UTF-8, tie by ascending position. ASCII decimal integers, lowercase input digest.
dispersed_reference.size: same number of positions as removed from the target block
dispersed_reference.interpretation: Requires 20 distinct qualifying control sets, exceedance of the reporting tolerance and a strictly larger change than every control. Descriptive comparison only.

hypotheses.H1: All eligible comparisons in the asserted domain stay within the corresponding endpoint tolerance.
hypotheses.H2: At least one eligible pair and interval exceeds its endpoint tolerance.

known_at_registration: Both deposited input files and earlier whole-chain summaries were public. New block-influence numeric answers had not been computed or viewed by this operator at the time of this protocol.
independence: Second deposit is delayed public comparison material. The two deposits share a publication; biological sampling independence is unknown. Independent numerical recomputation reuses the same originals.
